doc.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: How learning solos teaches improvisation
summary: He explains that learning solos shows the link between solo and song, and that young players get it only from records.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: When you played the solos, and you say that the solos taught you how to improvise, you learned the solos and you would learn the songs too.
And then you would just notice the relationship between the solo and the song?

Yeah. Then I found out, almost everybody learns that way, even the kids. Of course the difference is, I could hear Hawk in person. I could hear Lester in person. The young kids today don’t have that advantage. They have to strictly get it from the record.
